node.statement: Fix arbitrary n >= 1, row-stochastic Q: l_inf^n -> l_inf^n, and 0 <= eta <= eta_0 with ||Q^2-Q||_{infinity->infinity} <= eta, and define D,J,Q_C,Phi exactly as in the root. Since eta_0=eta_K, lem-routef-k-ledger applies and supplies a stochastic idempotent E for the same Q with ||Q-E||_{infinity->infinity} <= (K+4*sqrt(2*K))*sqrt(eta) = C*sqrt(eta).
